title: sigelo/0 verification result
description: The §9.1 result of verify(bundle, now). The six fields are the conformance surface and compared by value; key order is informative only. Implementations MAY attach per-item reasons alongside, so other top-level keys are allowed.

did.description: The current DID: the last entry of chain.

chain.description: Ordered DIDs from the original genesis to the current one.

recovery.description: The governing recovery commitment (SPEC §7.2), or null if the identity has none.

attestations.description: Accepted attestation bodies, verbatim, grouped by iss, in bundle order within each issuer.

bindings.description: Accepted binding bodies with their §6.1 proof status, in bundle order.
